messages:
Priya R: Big thank you to @Sam I and the infra/docs folks — you all pulled off that rollback like pros. Demo is back on. :trophy:
Sam I: Was a bit hairy for a minute, but we got it. Shoutout to @Ethan L for spotting the failing migration early.
Ethan L: Noted the error spikes and shouted in #eng-oncall. Glad it helped.
Maya T: I brought a box of brownies to the kitchen labeled 'Rollback Heroes' 36a, help yourselves tomorrow morning.
Leah O: Ordering breakfast to celebrate — bagels + GF muffins. If anyone wants a specific spread, reply here.
Priya R: Can someone paste the 3-step rollback snippet so I can add it to the incident note?
Sam I: Pasting quick notes:
```
# quick rollback steps
kubectl get pods -n prod | grep demo-service
kubectl rollout undo deployment/demo-service -n prod --to-revision=42
# if DB in bad state: run offline migration revert script
./scripts/db/revert_migration.sh --migration-id=2026-03-22-17
```
Priya R: Adding to the postmortem now. Will ping when it's live.
devex-bot: Kudos card created for the team (Kudos #9011). It'll be on the slide deck for All-Hands. :sparkles:
Ethan L: Tiny poll: brownies or bagels? React with :brownie: or :bagel:. Voting closes 7:30am.
Maya T: :brownie:
Sam I: :bagel: (but Ill take a brownie too)
Leah O: :bagel:
Priya R: Thanks again all. GLHF at the demo! :relieved:
